_source: Hand-written against Slack's Web API documentation for chat.postMessage (https://api.slack.com/methods/chat.postMessage) - the `message` object that method returns, with placeholder ids. Stripe's file is a verbatim subset of a stripe-mock release; Slack publishes no fixture set to vendor, so this one names the docs instead (#42). The message's `thread_ts` is a null placeholder rather than a value: the field exists so a threaded post's own `thread_ts` can be reflected onto it, and `echo.SlackEnvelope.optional` drops it again when the caller posted no thread, because real Slack sends the key only on a reply (#55).
